name: ChronoTrack Health
subtitle: Chronic Pain & Symptom Tracker
shortDescription: Track chronic pain privately. Discover symptom patterns, manage medications, generate doctor reports. Data stays on-device.
longDescription:
ChronoTrack Health helps you take control of your chronic condition. Log symptoms, track medications, discover patterns in your pain, and share doctor-ready
  reports — all while keeping your data 100% private on your device.

FEATURES (FREE)
  - Symptom Logging: Record pain level, body location, pain type, duration, and triggers
  - Calendar View: Visual pain heatmap showing your symptom history by day
  - Pattern Analysis: AI-powered on-device analysis identifies trends, triggers, and flare risks
  - Medication Tracking: Schedule medications, track adherence, and log doses
  - Daily Check-In: Track sleep, stress, energy, and overall wellness daily
  - Entry History: Browse and search all your logged entries
  - Emergency Card: Store emergency contacts, allergies, blood type, and conditions

PLUS ($3.99/month — Patient Premium)
  - Trigger Insights: Deep analysis of what causes your symptoms
  - Flare Timeline: Visual timeline of your flare episodes
  - Health Journal: Daily journal with mood tracking
  - Doctor Reports: Generate PDF and FHIR reports for appointments
  - Symptom Comparison: Side-by-side analysis of different periods
  - Medication Effectiveness: Track which medications help the most
  - Encrypted Backup: Secure your health data

PRO ($29.99/month — Healthcare Professionals)
  - Multi-Patient Dashboard: Manage multiple patients
  - SOAP Notes: Clinical report generator
  - Data Hub: Configure external data source connectors
  - Connector Store: Browse and add data sources
  - key Vault: Secure key management with budget controls
  - Audit Log: Full API call transparency
  - FHIR R4 Integration: Clinical interoperability

### Medical References
Every health insight includes tappable references from authoritative sources: NIH, WHO, CDC, FDA, APA, and AHA. Verify the science behind every recommendation.

IMPORTANT: ChronoTrack is a health tracking tool, not a substitute for professional medical care. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider for diagnosis and
   treatment.
